title: Registry Record Query — payload
description: An administrator queries a trust registry's stored records by an optional four-part key. All four parts supplied: an exact fetch of one record (notFound on a miss). Fewer parts: a filtered, cursor-paginated enumeration — fixing the pagination gap the superseded registry/record/list conceded. Key field names are verbatim TRQP (snake_case), matching the registry/* family.

entity_id.description: Filter to records for this entity.

authority_id.description: Filter to records asserted by this authority.

action.description: Filter to records for this action.

resource.description: Filter to records for this resource.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size; the registry clamps to 1..=200 (default 50). Ignored on a fully keyed exact fetch.

records.description: The matching trust records. Exactly one entry on a fully keyed fetch; zero or more per page on an enumeration.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page, or null/absent when this is the last.
